snippet.title: Exoshock VR Co-op Shooter | Official Trailer (2025)
snippet.description:
🔗 Join our Discord for playtests and updates: https://discord.gg/8t4NnwYnq7

Credits: Created by Demo Akuro, a storyteller driven by the power of imagination and the art of cinematic visuals.   ⁨@DemoAkuro⁩  https://demoakuro.co.uk/

Exoshock is a 1–4 player cooperative sci-fi VR shooter with full-body immersion, cinematic firefights, and tactical teamwork. Solo is supported.

WHAT YOU DO
• Board hostile starships, breach compartments, and clear corridors under fire.  
• Adapt to dynamic objectives and modifiers across handcrafted ship layouts.  
• Face reactive enemy AI that suppresses, flanks, grenades, and pushes you to coordinate.  
• Choose your role: deploy drones and sentries, anchor with heavy weapons, or push the frontline.  
• Built for replayability through a blend of handcrafted design and procedural variety.

PLATFORMS
• Meta Quest 3
• PCVR via SteamVR

GET INVOLVED
• Join the Discord to get notified about playtests and Closed Alpha opportunities.  
• Share feedback to help shape balance, mission flow, and VR interactions.

📌 Wishlist Exoshock
• Meta Quest: https://www.meta.com/experiences/exoshock/9912140795471966/  
• Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549390/EXOSHOCK/

📺 Subscribe for devlogs and gameplay
• https://www.youtube.com/@exoshock

CREDITS
• Developed by Polarity One
